tool.name: analyze_docx_structure_tool
tool.description: Interpret a native DOCX structure graph using deterministic OOXML and optional layout evidence plus a text model. Produces additive relationship enrichments; it never replaces the native BADGERS spine and does not consume document pixels.

document_structure_graph.description: JSON graph of stable OOXML-derived nodes. Each node has id, type, order, optional parent/list/anchor/reference fields, and optional normalized renderer layout.

structure_graph_uri.description: S3 URI containing the JSON document structure graph. Use instead of document_structure_graph for large graphs.

source_document_path.description: S3 URI or source path of the Word document.

scope_id.description: Stable native scope identifier, such as a document, section, or page scope.

page_number.description: Optional page number when the supplied graph is a renderer-derived page scope.

specialist.name: docx_structure_specialist
specialist.description: Derives evidence-backed structural, referential, and optional layout relationship enrichments from a native DOCX graph.
